description: Section 8 website Razorpay Standard Checkout code path (initiation keeps DISABLED by default), wired to the FEAT-001 calculator so the gateway amount equals collection+fee+GST. Create a server-stored Razorpay gateway-order binding, a callback-verify endpoint keyed on the SERVER-STORED gateway order id, and a documented website contract replacing the old PAYMENT_REQUEST_SENT handoff. Raw-body webhook HMAC already exists and is reused. Razorpay client is mocked in tests; no live provider call (AWS/secrets BLOCKED).
steps: Add a server-side Razorpay order-create path (new lambda_utils/integrations module function or extend razorpay_verify's sibling) that: requires session/profile/cart/quote ownership and a valid immutable FEAT-001 quote snapshot; computes the payable via checkout_pricing (NOT the raw Wix total); reserves a durable customer-scoped request key/fingerprint BEFORE any external call (same-key/same-intent resumes, changed-intent rejects); persists the Razorpay gateway order id/account/mode/amount binding before exposing checkout options; disables partial payment. Keep it behind the existing CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED gate (default off) so a disabled gate creates no payable gateway order.

Add a browser-result callback-verify handler that validates the Razorpay checkout signature (HMAC) using the SERVER-STORED gateway order id, then still requires authoritative captured-payment verification via razorpay_verify before any paid state. Return only public key id, stored gateway order id, approved amount/currency, allowed prefill and owned attempt reference to the browser.

Document the website contract (replacing PAYMENT_REQUEST_SENT) in the checkout handler docstring and in src/pages/cart.tsx handling, WITHOUT removing the retained legacy in-chat response until callers are migrated (flag the in-WhatsApp vs website owner decision from findings.md; do not delete the in-chat path).

Tests: tests/test_razorpay_binding.py and new tests covering provider-create timeout/save-failure ambiguity (no blind second payable order), changed-intent rejection, concurrent request-key coordination, callback HMAC failure against stored order id, wrong stored order/account/amount/currency rejection, and that a disabled initiation gate yields no gateway order. All Razorpay/Wix calls mocked.
acceptance_criteria: With initiation disabled, no payable Razorpay gateway order is created (test-asserted)
Callback verification uses the server-stored gateway order id and a signed browser success still requires provider-verified capture (test-asserted)
The gateway amount equals the FEAT-001 calculator total, not the raw Wix total (test-asserted)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q stays green, 0 failed; tsc clean if any TS changed; vitest green if cart.tsx changed
findings:
Committed as 8800aa66 on branch stack. VERIFICATION (all re-run after change): pytest tests/test_razorpay_binding.py tests/test_payment_readiness.py = 73 passed; full .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q = 5666 passed, 1 skipped (was 5653 baseline, +13 new); npx tsc --noEmit = clean exit 0; npx vitest run = 643 passed, 44 files. cart.tsx change was comment/docstring-only (no behavior change). BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT: no live Razorpay order-create/capture performed (AWS/secrets unavailable per context); all provider/Wix/boto calls are mocked in tests, and any live create/capture/deploy step is deferred to the owner. The in-WhatsApp vs website owner decision (findings.md section 3) is honored: the website path is additive and gated OFF by default; the legacy PAYMENT_REQUEST_SENT in-chat response is retained, not removed.

POST-REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (review 2026-10-01-090643-review.md, APPROVED with 3 non-blocking findings): Finding 1 (ACTIONABLE) addressed by wiring the stored account/mode check into verify_callback. The binding persists accountMode + accountKeyId expressly so 'a test-mode success must never settle a live-mode order' (order_keys.bind_gateway_order / razorpay_orders.account_mode docstrings), but verify_callback previously read back only amountPaise + currency and never consulted the stored mode/account. verify_callback now takes an injected account_mode_of classifier (razorpay_orders.account_mode, same injected-dependency style as prepare_checkout) and, before the HMAC/capture checks can settle, refuses the settle (CALLBACK_BINDING_MISMATCH) when the mode the stored accountKeyId resolves to disagrees with the stored accountMode, or when the stored mode is empty/unknown. This consults the exact stored field the binding persists to enforce the invariant, rather than justifying a no-op. (The capture readback itself already runs against a single documented account wecare/razorpay/api so a cross-account capture cannot authenticate; this closes the remaining gap at the stored binding where the invariant was recorded.) Finding 2 (INFORMATIONAL, no code change): retained in-chat PAYMENT_REQUEST_SENT coexisting with the website contract is a deliberate owner decision per findings.md; left as-is. Finding 3 (INFORMATIONAL, no code change): both money paths delegate 'did money move' to the pre-existing unchanged razorpay_verify, out of scope for this diff; left as-is. Changed files: amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/website_checkout.py (verify_callback account/mode cross-check + docstrings); tests/test_razorpay_binding.py (+3 tests: stored mode disagreeing with stored key does not settle, unknown mode does not settle, matching mode settles; existing paid-path test now passes account_mode_of as the positive control).
